title: Harness preset manifest
description: Describes what a preset package inherits and what it provides. A preset is a governance specification: it declares paths to documents inside its own package, and `entry` declares the module through which a preset that also ships code registers its extensions.

name.description: The package name. It must match the package the manifest was resolved from, otherwise two presets could claim one identity.

extends.description: Package names this preset inherits from. Names only, never versions: versions belong to package.json and the lockfile.

policy.description: Path to a policy document inside this package.

agents.description: Path to an agent configuration document inside this package.

instruction.description: Path to a markdown document used to seed the target project's AGENTS.md.

entry.description: Path to the module that registers this preset's extensions (evidence providers, reviewer definitions). Declared for forward compatibility: the resolver checks only that the path stays inside the package and exists, and no runtime loads it yet (M21).

verification.description: Path to the checks document this preset declares, relative to the package. Its checks are unioned with every other resolved source, and each becomes a rule id a policy may address. The analyzers a declaration names are supplied separately.

rules.description: Declared for forward compatibility; no runtime consumes it yet.
